newsitem.title: USA: Barr Laboratories to invest $5 million.
newsitem.headline: Barr Laboratories to invest $5 million.

text.p: Barr Laboratories Inc said Tuesday that it will make a $5 million strategic equity investment in Warner Chilcott, a private prescription drug maker.
However, Warner Chilcot plans a public share offering before the end of July.
In a statement, Barr said that in return for the investment, Warner Chilcott will utilize Barr to manufacture and distribute certain generic versions of its branded products.
Barr, a generic drug manufacturer, said the terms of the agreement give it the opportunity to double that investment within the next four years.
Barr Laboratories fell 13/16 to close at 41-1/16 in Tuesday's American Stock Exchange trading.
